title: Numbers from 1 to 20!
summary: Practise counting and writing English numbers from 1 to 20.
keyIdeas: Start with 1 to 10: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
Numbers from 13 to 19 end in -teen, as in fourteen and sixteen.

activities.prompt: Match each number to its word.
activities.explanation: 1 is one, 2 is two, 3 is three, 4 is four, and 5 is five.

activities.prompt: Hugo has 7 pencils. How do you write 7?
activities.explanation: 7 is seven. Six is 6, and eight is 8.

activities.prompt: The number after nine is ten.
activities.explanation: We count eight, nine, ten. Ten comes after nine.

activities.prompt: Put these numbers in order from smallest to largest.
activities.explanation: The order from 6 to 10 is six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

activities.prompt: Choose the number that finishes the sequence.
activities.explanation: Thirteen (13) comes after twelve (12). Three is 3, and thirty is 30.

activities.prompt: Sort these number words into the right group.
activities.explanation: Two (2), four (4) and eight (8) are from 1 to 10. Fifteen (15), sixteen (16) and twenty (20) are from 11 to 20.

activities.prompt: Aisha has eight blue stickers and two red stickers. How many stickers does she have?
activities.explanation: Eight (8) plus two (2) equals ten (10). Aisha has ten stickers.
14 is fourteen. Four is 4, and forty is 40.
activities.hint: It begins with four- and ends with -teen.
activities.sentence: Omar is 14 today. He has ___ candles.

activities.prompt: Read the story and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: The English number words tell us exactly how many marbles each child has.
activities.title: Marbles at Break Time
activities.text: Leo and Mia play a game. Leo has eleven green marbles. Mia has fifteen yellow marbles. They count their own marbles.

questions.prompt: How many green marbles does Leo have?
questions.explanation: Leo has eleven green marbles. Eleven means 11.

questions.prompt: How many yellow marbles does Mia have?
questions.explanation: Mia has fifteen yellow marbles. Fifteen means 15.

activities.prompt: Put the numbers from 16 to 20 in order.
activities.explanation: The sequence is sixteen (16), seventeen (17), eighteen (18), nineteen (19), twenty (20).
